entries.purpose: Qualified initial 9-atom ethanol geometry (angstrom) bound as the ORCA xyzfile dependency

proposal.reason: Correcting the rejected proposal's parameter value error: the ORCA program CodeRef is declared with language 'orca' so its declared language matches its bytes, while geometry stays in the parameters.inputs manifest. No Step is ready (pending_step_ids empty) and the geometry Goal is settled, so this revise_plan adds the missing managed ORCA execution. The already-written job.inp (artifact_bd0c6112..., sha 1e307b78...) contains B3LYP/def2-TZVP Opt Freq, %maxcore 192, bounded scf MaxIter 256 and geom MaxIter 128, AutoTRAH false, NoAutoStart, and '* xyzfile 0 1 coords.xyz'; the qualified prepared ethanol XYZ (artifact_e3a7afaf..., sha 5341a7b8...) is bound as coords.xyz, preserving the 9-atom initial identity anchor and its atom ordering.
